lyricsSearch.description: Accepts { "query": string } and returns { "title": string, "url": string, "source": string } using DuckDuckGo/SerpAPI enrichment.
notes: Use SerpAPI when SERPAPI_KEY is configured, otherwise fall back to DuckDuckGo.

melodySearch.description: Accepts { "fingerprint": string } derived from audio embeddings and calls ACRCloud.
notes: Fallback to local database when offline.

fetchPlayable.description: Transforms a canonical track payload into a playable media URL using yt-dlp or cached assets.

playbackEvents.description: Optional hook for logging playback telemetry.
notes: Can be used to update history dashboards.
